hypothesis: Risk-aware camp selection with recovery when no feasible target remains will increase matched development win rate and mean submitted gems without new bot faults.
mechanism: Current farming ranks reward/time without a health budget. Estimate 0.60 * summed remaining camp strength * remaining HP / (1.12 * self strength), apply completed Jungle and Durability multipliers, and reject predicted clears below the existing 35% max-health reserve. Wounded farmers with no feasible target recover instead of idling.
falsifier: Non-positive matched win change, non-increasing mean submitted gems, or any new own fault.
evidence_limits: Boss finals motivate survival/throughput work; they do not identify per-turn pull choices or prove causal attribution. PvP remains a separate major loss mode.
smoke_summary: Both Collision games completed, winners A then B, zero faults and fuel suspensions on both sides. Scores 1010:0 at round540 and22:1002 at round557. Opponent revisions unknown; no comparative strength claim.
